summary: A county sweep that cannot fetch every location must fail instead of returning a partial notice set, and agenda snippets must come from the original text after a Unicode-safe case-insensitive match.
reason: Partial location failures previously returned as success, so since recorded an incomplete seen-set and millard/landuse/agenda/watch silently omitted towns. Unicode ToLower can change UTF-8 length, so match offsets must map back onto the original agenda rather than slicing the lowercased copy.
validated_outcome: go test covers partial-sweep fail-closed, unicode snippet validity, land-use filters, locations registry, and since/watch SQLite persistence.
